title: Mercedes OM651 (CRD3-MFA1) - XENTRY guided tests and cold-start fault codes
notes: Every entry is graded 'candidate' -- none has run on a car yet.

ROUTINES ARE ACTIVE TESTS. Service 0x31 commands the ECU; several of them spin the starter, drive injectors or run the fuel pump. They are not the read-only 0x22 reads the capture uses. Run them only deliberately, with the car safe to crank, and expect an extended session (10 03) and possibly SecurityAccess first.

The CBF declares BigEndian on every parameter of every Mercedes ECU mined so far, yet the SLK's SIM271DE20 answered LITTLE-endian on the car (2026-08-23). declared_byte_order is recorded but not trusted; decode both ways and keep the raw bytes.
Result field byte_offset is absolute in the whole reply frame (service byte included), unlike the 0x22 tables whose offsets start after the 62 <DID> header.

dyn_hydraulic.title: Dynamic hydraulic test
dyn_hydraulic.why: Spins the starter and reports the AVERAGED rail pressure during cranking, the pressure after the up and down states, how long the pressure took to fall, and the engine speed at the end. This is the closest dealer equivalent of the extended-crank complaint.
